summary: 100-foot lookout tower announced for Semmes, Mobile County, in Dec 1929; TopoQuest separately lists a Semmes Lookout Tower in Mobile County. No completion date or current status found.

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources. The 1929 notice announces a planned tower, so it is recorded as 'other', not 'built'; no completion report was found. The TopoQuest map record gives coordinates N30.765466 W88.250839, which match the brief's 30.7653, -88.2507 to four decimals, but it has no date or status, so tying it to the 1929 tower is an inference from location. The story does not tie the two records together. Wikipedia's Semmes, Alabama page has no tower mention. Two WebSearch calls found nothing further on construction, operator or removal. Brief agency is blank and no agency is supported by the sources read; the 1929 notice names only a division forester. Status and access unknown and omitted; the story says no source describes the site now. Verification pass: the 100-foot and 'smallest of two towers' details were in the notice but missing from the evidence list, so both quotes were added.
